register_changes_text_check.name: register_changes_text_check
register_changes_text_check.value: ("ingenium"."register_changes"."kind" <> 'note' or "ingenium"."register_changes"."text" is not null) and ("ingenium"."register_changes"."text" is null or btrim("ingenium"."register_changes"."text") <> '')

register_checks_closed_check.name: register_checks_closed_check
register_checks_closed_check.value: ("ingenium"."register_checks"."status" in ('resolved', 'cancelled')) = ("ingenium"."register_checks"."closed_at" is not null) and ("ingenium"."register_checks"."closed_at" is null) = ("ingenium"."register_checks"."closed_by_name" is null)

register_checks_closed_note_check.name: register_checks_closed_note_check
register_checks_closed_note_check.value: "ingenium"."register_checks"."status" not in ('resolved', 'cancelled', 'sent_back') or "ingenium"."register_checks"."note" is not null

register_inputs_party_check.name: register_inputs_party_check
register_inputs_party_check.value: "ingenium"."register_inputs"."external_party" is null or ("ingenium"."register_inputs"."external_party" in ('process', 'mechanical', 'electrical', 'automation', 'client', 'site', 'purchasing', 'project_management') and "ingenium"."register_inputs"."external_party" not in ('process', 'mechanical', 'electrical', 'automation'))

register_inputs_title_check.name: register_inputs_title_check
register_inputs_title_check.value: ("ingenium"."register_inputs"."external_party" is null and "ingenium"."register_inputs"."external_title" is null) or ("ingenium"."register_inputs"."external_party" is not null and "ingenium"."register_inputs"."external_title" is not null and btrim("ingenium"."register_inputs"."external_title") <> '')

register_inputs_ack_check.name: register_inputs_ack_check
register_inputs_ack_check.value: ("ingenium"."register_inputs"."acknowledged_at" is null) = ("ingenium"."register_inputs"."acknowledged_by_name" is null) and ("ingenium"."register_inputs"."acknowledged_by_name" is null or btrim("ingenium"."register_inputs"."acknowledged_by_name") <> '')

free_tasks_cancel_check.name: free_tasks_cancel_check
free_tasks_cancel_check.value: ("ingenium"."free_tasks"."state" = 'cancelled') = ("ingenium"."free_tasks"."cancel_reason" is not null) and ("ingenium"."free_tasks"."cancel_reason" is null or btrim("ingenium"."free_tasks"."cancel_reason") <> '')
